purpose: Determine whether the deferred aggregate NPL response equation has a definitionally complete Romania source boundary before any risk-model estimation.

exact_risk_source.concept: Gross non-performing loans and advances as percent of total gross loans and advances, domestic banks, FINREP reporters, Romania
exact_risk_source.coverage: 2014-Q4 to 2025-Q3 in the indexed ECB Data Portal evidence reviewed on 2026-09-19
exact_risk_source.semantic_limit: The aggregate banking-system NPL ratio is a stock-quality outcome affected by recognition, cures, write-offs, sales and portfolio composition; it is not a pure borrower-default incidence measure.

evidence: BNR Financial Stability Report, December 2023 directly reports mortgage NPL = 1.7 percent in September 2023 and plots mortgage NPL separately from consumer and total household credit.
BNR Financial Stability Report, June 2024 directly reports mortgage NPL = 1.7 percent in March 2024, versus 5.9 percent for consumer loans and 3.3 percent for household bank loans overall.
The BNR charts show longer mortgage-NPL histories, but chart digitisation is prohibited and no exact machine-readable mortgage-NPL series has yet been retained.
sector_specific_npl_family.rule: Do not replace the exact aggregate ECB CBD2 NPL target with mortgage NPL after viewing fit. Any mortgage target requires a separately preregistered target/source contract and exact machine-readable retained history.

available_but_non_equivalent_sources.concept: Quarterly loan stocks and financial transactions for households/NFCs
available_but_non_equivalent_sources.why_not_debt_service: Stocks and net loan transactions do not identify scheduled principal repayments plus interest service on the same borrower boundary.

available_but_non_equivalent_sources.why_not_use_proxy: Country coverage or total-private-sector measures may not be silently substituted for an exact Romania household/NFC debt-service burden.

available_but_non_equivalent_sources.concept: Housing-loan borrower/portfolio DSTI for new and outstanding mortgage loans, with direct publication-text observations 2023-Q1..2025-Q2
available_but_non_equivalent_sources.why_not_use_proxy: Outstanding housing-loan DSTI is conceptually closer to a mortgage NPL stock than to the registered aggregate NPL target, but exact reporting-population, bank-coverage, weighting and machine-readable joint-history compatibility with the mortgage NPL source are not demonstrated. It may not be used for the aggregate target or silently promote a mortgage target.

debt_service_boundary.prohibited_measurement_model: Do not synthesize debt service as debt stock times a lending rate plus assumed amortisation/maturity without a separately preregistered measurement model and independent validation.

dti_o_boundary.source: BNR Central Credit Register / Financial Stability Report, June 2024
dti_o_boundary.concept: DTI-O = total borrower debt / annual disposable income at origination
dti_o_boundary.rule: DTI-O is leverage at origination, not scheduled debt service relative to income, and may not substitute for DSTI/debt_service.

output_growth_boundary.rule: The activity variable must be selected ex ante on the same target/portfolio boundary before fit; aggregate GDP and NFC GVA are not interchangeable.

lag_and_stock_dynamics.rho_NPL_lag_role: The lagged NPL ratio is mechanically observable once the target series is fixed, but including rho does not resolve causal identification.
lag_and_stock_dynamics.recognition_delay: NPL recognition and supervisory/accounting changes may create delays or breaks; lag order must be preregistered, not selected from holdout performance.
lag_and_stock_dynamics.boundary_2014_note: The harmonised FINREP/EBA-era quarterly series begins in 2014-Q4 in the retained ECB evidence and should not be silently concatenated with older national definitions.

reasons: The exact registered aggregate NPL target remains available, but no definitionally matched aggregate Romania debt-service burden has been retained.

A narrower BNR mortgage NPL and housing-loan DSTI source family is now observed in official publications, but no exact machine-readable, jointly reconciled portfolio history has been retained and the mortgage target has not been preregistered.
BNR DTI-O is an origination leverage ratio rather than debt-service burden and has incomplete reported coverage; it cannot close the debt-service term.
The output/activity observable is not frozen on either the aggregate or possible future mortgage portfolio boundary.
Lag structure and treatment of NPL recognition, cures, write-offs, sales and regulatory/portfolio breaks are not preregistered.
source_admissibility.reduced_form_rule: Dropping debt service or estimating an output-plus-lag equation because debt service is unavailable requires a new preregistered candidate-family contract and independent evaluation design.

future_reopen_paths.requirement: Retain an observed debt-service burden definitionally aligned to the aggregate NPL target, then freeze activity and lag/break treatment before any new candidate-family contract.

Retain exact machine-readable mortgage NPL and housing-loan burden histories, reconcile their reporting population/coverage/weighting, freeze a mortgage-aligned activity variable, and preregister a new sector-specific target/form before estimation.

prohibited_shortcuts: Construct debt service from loan stock multiplied by a new-business lending rate.
Assume an amortisation schedule or average maturity to manufacture principal service.
Use loan transactions as principal repayments.
Use debt-to-income or debt-to-GDP as a debt-service burden.
Choose aggregate versus sector-specific NPL after model fit.
Concatenate pre-2014 national NPL definitions with the harmonised FINREP series without an explicit bridge.
Drop the debt-service term and fit a nested model without preregistration.
Treat DTI-O as debt-service burden or DSTI.
Assume mortgage NPL and housing-loan DSTI have identical reporting populations because both refer to housing loans.
Digitise BNR mortgage-NPL charts to manufacture a canonical target history.
Switch from aggregate to mortgage NPL after inspecting model fit.
